messages:
sanjay: Quick sync — finished a pass on audit coverage for API gateway, auth, console, billing, and runtime. Found gaps we should triage this sprint. TL;DR: gateway + auth are highest risk, runtime has a bunch of missing event types, billing is missing customer-visible invoice accesses.

maria: thanks. can you paste the matrix or link? :eyes:

sanjay: matrix here: https://redwood.internal/engsec/audit-matrix (read-only). Key findings:
- API gateway: missing upstream identity propagation events (x-forwarded-user), missing route-level deny/allow logging for 403s.
- Auth (identity svc): no explicit RBAC-change audit events (grant/revoke roles), KMS key-wrap operations logged only to debug level.
- Console (frontend): admin UI actions are only recorded as generic `ui_action` without structured fields (actor, target, change).
- Billing: invoice download/view events are not customer-visible in audit export.
- Runtime: model load/unload, quantization profile changes, and kernel selection overrides aren't audited. Also KV cache evictions that affect determinism aren't logged.

alex: ugh. agree gateway + auth first. those map to compliance asks from AcmeCorp. we should add canaries to verify parity for customer-facing audit exports.

tj: proposal: create minimal required schema changes for event types: `rbac_change`, `kms_key_op`, `gateway_policy_eval`, `billing_invoice_view`, `runtime_model_lifecycle`. each needs structured fields: actor.id, actor.type, target.id, action, before/after (if applicable), request_id, at least INFO level.

sanjay: +1. rough schema snippet for `rbac_change`:
```json
{
  "event_type": "rbac_change",
  "actor": {"id": "u-123", "type": "user"},
  "target": {"id": "team-foo", "type": "group"},
  "action": "grant_role",
  "role": "dedicated_admin",
  "before": ["viewer"],
  "after": ["viewer","dedicated_admin"],
  "request_id": "req-abc123",
  "timestamp": "2025-07-12T14:23:01Z"
}
```

maria: perfect. let's ensure sensitive fields (like key material) never end up in the export. KMS ops should log key ids and op type, NOT key material.

audit-bot: Reminder: export schema changes require 2-week review + privacy sign-off per policy ENG-PRIV-07.

sanjay: noted. timeline idea: this sprint (2w) do discovery + design + small prototype for gateway events; next sprint implement auth events + console schema; add runtime/billing as backlog with owners.

tj: owners suggestion: gateway -> alex, auth -> sanjay, console -> maria, billing -> tj, runtime -> alex. I can pick up schema PRs for auth and billing if needed.

alex: I can take gateway and runtime, but runtime will need more design time (kernel selection events are messy). recommend we split runtime into: model lifecycle (high prio) and perf/telemetry events (later).

maria: I'll do console cleanup. will add tests to ensure actor/target fields present and included in CSV/JSON export.

sanjay: action items (I'll create ENGSEC board tickets):
- ENGSEC-5021 Gateway: add `gateway_policy_eval` + route deny logging (owner: alex, prio: P0)
- ENGSEC-5022 Auth: add `rbac_change` + KMS op logging (owner: sanjay, prio: P0)
- ENGSEC-5023 Console: structured admin events (owner: maria, prio: P1)
- ENGSEC-5024 Billing: export invoice_view event (owner: tj, prio: P2)
- ENGSEC-5025 Runtime: model lifecycle audit (owner: alex, prio: P1)

tj: can we also add an acceptance test matrix? basically: end-to-end event appears in export, fields present, scrubbed of secrets, and timestamped.

sanjay: yes — I'll add an acceptance checklist to each ticket. checklist items: `event_present`, `fields_validated`, `no_secret_leak`, `export_ok`, `backfill_plan_if_needed`.

alex: estimate: gateway + auth PRs = 1.5 sprint dev work if we parallelize. runtime model lifecycle probably another 1 sprint.
maria: anything blocking on infra (log schema change / elastic mapping)?
sanjay: storage side: we need a mapping bump for structured fields; eng-infra needs ~1 day to schedule reindexing window. will coordinate with infra.
audit-bot: New ticket created ENGSEC-5021 by sanjay.

maria: ok i'm going to start a small schema doc in the design doc folder and tag privacy. ping me if you want to review.
tj: i'll create the acceptance test harness task and pair with QA.
sanjay: thanks everyone. I'll run a brief triage meeting tomorrow 10:30am PT to finalize owners and get infra slot. If you can't make it, drop a note in this thread. :calendar:

alex: I'll be there.
maria: same.
tj: might be on call, will try to join.

sanjay: last note — if anyone sees audit logs that look like they contain secret material during testing, stop and DM security immediately. we don't want accidental key leaks in ephemeral logs. :lock:

(edited)
